changelog: The first screen. vibe start is now seven lines: who you are, what's waiting, how many others are here, and where to go next. No message bodies, no chosen person, no drafted DM, no rotating tips. And it only says what it actually read — if your inbox or the room can't be reached it says so, instead of showing you a confident zero.
features: vibe start is seven lines and states the unread count exactly once
A failed read is never rendered as an empty inbox or an empty room
No message bodies on the first screen, and nobody is chosen for you
A read that did not succeed can no longer authorize a write — six places where one corrupt line destroyed messages, profiles, presence or your credential
vibe token no longer says “old local keys removed” unless they are gone
